name: Flat battery in French
title: A flat battery, continued in French, with echo
summary: The caller sits in his car with the phone on the dash, so the agent's voice echoes back. He switches to French and gives up if the agent stays in English. He has a flight to catch: if the arrival time ignores his 2 pm deadline he objects, and if nothing sooner is offered he takes a taxi.

golden.scenario: Caller's car won't start at home and he needs to leave for the airport at 2 pm.
golden.expected_outcome: After the switch the agent speaks French for the rest of the call. The agent never stops for, or answers, its own echo. A battery call-out is sent to 42 rue des Érables, appartement 3, for a 2019 Mazda 3. The agent gives an arrival time before the 2 pm deadline and the price of a replacement battery.
